title: Viet Youth Resources
tagline: Greater Sacramento — high school and college

org.name: Community Partners Advocate of Little Saigon Sacramento

hero.headline: Know your peers. Know what's on the calendar.
hero.body: A local map of Vietnamese student clubs and the opportunities vying for your attention — so every chapter sees the field.

intro.headline: What this is
intro.body: For VSA and Viet culture club officers and members in Greater Sacramento. Peer Instagrams plus ways to plug into free community and regional youth programs. This is not membership in cPALSs — and not a new high school alliance.

chapters.headline: Peer map
chapters.lead: Local chapters and culture clubs. Follow each other. Cross-invite. Know who else is recruiting and performing this year.

bands.label: High school
bands.note: EGUSD Vietnamese Student Associations and culture clubs

adjacent.name: Red Lotus
adjacent.note: Sac State dance / lion — campus-adjacent, not the VSA board

adjacent.name: VISTA @ UCD
adjacent.note: UC Davis VSA high school outreach — college students mentoring / bridging HS clubs

opportunities.headline: Opportunities
opportunities.lead: Programs that want your club's calendar — attend, enroll, volunteer, or sponsor. Owned by different orgs; listed here so you see the whole field.

items.name: Little Saigon Krewe
items.when: Sat Oct 24, 2026 · Golden Harvest Parade · Capitol Mall
items.about: A composite Vietnamese community block in Sacramento's civic parade — clubs, troupes, and courts march together under one krewe.

plugIn.text: Watch on Capitol Mall; bring family
Register your club as a subunit — krewe.cpalss.com
Help build and run the block — contact@cpalss.com (subject: Krewe)
Cash or in-kind — same inbox

items.name: Elk Grove Toy Drive
items.about: A free family evening — Santa, dinner, crafts, entertainment — while unwrapped toys go to local charities. Sponsors fund the fete; volunteers make the magic.

plugIn.text: Free guest — elkgrovetoydrive.com
Staff / directors or day-of shifts — contact@cpalss.com
Cash or in-kind — elkgrovetoydrive.com/fund-the-fete/

items.name: Elk Grove Lunar New Year
items.when: Sat–Sun Feb 13–14, 2027 · Elk Grove Park · free admission
items.about: A free family festival weekend for Tết — carnival, lion dance, kids programming, local music — co-hosted with coalition partners.

highlight.label: Youth Culture Day
highlight.text: Sunday stage lane for EGUSD cultural clubs (advisor sign-off) — dance and culture sets, not college performers.

plugIn.text: Free both days — eglny.com
Vendor, performer, or school/club activation — eglny.com or contact@cpalss.com
Season roles or day-of — contact@cpalss.com (subject: LNY)
Fund The Festival — eglny.com/fund-the-festival/

items.name: Miss & Miss Teen Vietnam Northern California
items.when: Next pageant date TBA (2027 hosting not locked)
items.about: Empowers young Vietnamese American women through pageantry, leadership, and community appearances — including festival and parade moments with cPALSs.

plugIn.text: Pageant night and court appearances (watch for announcement)
Compete as a candidate, or invite the court to your event — contact@cpalss.com (subject: MV NORCAL)
Pageant production and appearance support — same inbox
Cash or in-kind for pageant and court — same inbox

groups.note: United Vietnamese Student Associations of Northern California — regional collegiate union. cPALSs lists these so Sac chapters see them; UVSA runs them.

items.name: Summit
items.when: Annual regional convention — dates on norcaluvsa.org
items.about: Regional convention for member-school VSAs — staff or attend. Strong chapters staff; thinner chapters get turnkey programming without inventing the event.

plugIn.text: Register when Summit opens — norcaluvsa.org / @norcaluvsa
Staff or send your chapter — member-school pathway via your VSA board / ICC

items.name: Camp Horizon
items.when: Summer camp (typically August) — dates on norcaluvsa.org
items.about: Summer camp with registration and family-leader programming — a membership activity for NorCal UVSA chapters.

plugIn.text: Camp registration when posted — norcaluvsa.org / @norcaluvsa
Chapter and individual paths via UVSA — watch IG and the union site

items.name: SPARKS
items.when: One-day High School Summit — typically May (also ran Nov 2025); dates on norcaluvsa.org
items.about: NorCal UVSA's high school college/career bridge — workshops and networking with college students. Not a high school federation; a day to meet the collegiate field.

plugIn.text: Register when SPARKS opens — norcaluvsa.org / @norcaluvsa
Bring your HS club — watch UVSA IG for announcements

coming.headline: More coming
coming.body: Partner programs — including Lạc Hồng (Vietnamese language school) and other youth-facing orgs — will be listed here so chapters see the full field. Watch this page for updates.

contact.headline: Stay current
contact.body: Questions, corrections, or a club we should add? Email us. Season dates change — refresh this page when programs announce.
